title: Hypatia Learned Security Rules
description: Named-field JSON replacement for two retired, mutually incompatible Logtalk security_rule/4 exports: Hypatia's generated (Type, Category, AutoFix, Count) and ECHIDNA's (Type, Category, Severity, AutoFix). Produced by `mix hypatia.batch_security_scan`; semantics are Hypatia.Rules.SecurityErrors.validate_alert/1 plus the observation count. See docs/rules/logtalk-migration.adoc for the field-by-field mapping.

schema.description: Schema identifier for this document shape

version.description: Semantic version of the export format

source_alert_count.description: Total code-scanning alerts the rules were learned from

rules.description: One object per distinct alert type, sorted by observations descending then alert_type

alert_type.description: GitHub code-scanning / Scorecard alert id (first positional field in both retired Logtalk exports)

category.description: Canonical alert category (second positional field in both retired exports; snake-case as in the retired ECHIDNA module). ERROR-CATALOG.scm kebab-case names map by hyphen to underscore.

severity.description: Classified severity (ECHIDNA export field 3 / Logtalk classify_severity/2; absent from Hypatia's old generator. Canonical source SecurityErrors.issue_severity/1)

auto_fixable.description: Whether an automated fix exists (Hypatia generator field 3, ECHIDNA export field 4; Logtalk is_auto_fixable/1)

observations.description: Alerts of this type seen in the source scan (Hypatia generator field 4; absent from ECHIDNA's export). An observation count is belief-formation evidence, never a soundness claim: see schema/findings.ncl and src/Hypatia/ABI/Verdict.idr.

fix.description: Suggested fix text (Logtalk suggest_fix/2), or null when none is recorded

prevention_workflow.description: Prevention workflow template name (Logtalk get_prevention_workflow/2), or null when none is recorded
